in_sample_note:
Everything here reads ``results/processed/<campaign>/`` (and, for trace figures, the raw
trace files when present). Nothing is simulated. Results computed on a discovery/pilot
campaign are *in-sample and descriptive*: the same mutants define admissibility and, when
greedy ordering is used, the battery order. Only the gated held-out evaluation tests the
study hypothesis. Statistical outputs on few base models are flagged unreliable by the
analysis functions themselves.

paired_battery_vs_canonical_in_sample.exact_mcnemar_note: two-sided exact binomial on discordant pairs; assumes independent mutants

cluster_bootstrap.statistic: pooled paired difference in detection rate (a - b)
cluster_bootstrap.ci_method: cluster percentile bootstrap (base models resampled with replacement)
cluster_bootstrap.warning: only 2 base-model cluster(s) (< 5): the cluster bootstrap has few distinct resamples and its percentile interval is unreliable

cluster_permutation.statistic_definition: sum over base models of (only_a - only_b)
cluster_permutation.warning: only 2 base-model cluster(s) (< 5): the sign-flip test has few distinct sign patterns and low attainable significance
cluster_permutation.assumption: independent base models; per-model discordant difference symmetric about 0 under H0
